faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The essentials about taxi and transfer Tatariv — Bukovel

price.q: How much is a taxi from Tatariv to Bukovel?
price.a: The price is fixed and depends on the route and the car. We'll tell you the exact amount by phone or Telegram before the trip — no extra charges on the way.

order.q: How do I book a taxi in Tatariv?
order.a: Call +380 96 887 11 34 or message us on Telegram. Tell us where from, where to and what time — we'll confirm the time and the price.

night.q: Do you work at night and on weekends?
night.a: Yes, our taxi in Tatariv runs 24/7, every day. Early-morning and night rides are best booked in advance.

group.q: Can I book a transfer for a group?
group.a: Yes. The Renault Trafic seats up to 8 passengers with luggage, the BMW 320 up to 4.

childSeat.q: Do you have a child seat?
childSeat.a: Yes, child seats are available. Please mention it when booking.

luggage.q: Can you take skis and snowboards?
luggage.a: Yes, there is room for skis, snowboards and suitcases. Luggage is free of charge.

payment.a: Cash or card — whatever works for you.
